Lina: quick sync: partners requested clarity on H200 thermal derate notes before committing to our early-access SKU list.
Arman: can we surface the derate numbers? ops has some tails on 95th pct.
Derek: also need to confirm marketplace image signing and driver white-listing timelines. some partners will only pass through if we support their signed drivers.
Nina: FYI our PR window for partner co-announce is May 12-18. partners asked for a hard lock two weeks prior.
Lina: propose: embargo lock by Apr 28, early-access partner list by Apr 25. anyone object?
Arman: ok from eng-infra, but we need firmware GA dates from vendors by Apr 20.
Derek: ops-bot kicked off compatibility scan for H200 and B200 images. results due 04-23.
ops-bot: compatibility-scan started for images: h200-b200-mi300-gaudi. ETA 2026-04-23 12:00 UTC.
Nina: putting together marketplace image checklist and will attach to invite. also cc'ing PR.
Lina: great. final: let's capture contingency: if firmware slips, we fall back to MI300-only announcement and stagger H-series later.
Arman: sounds good. I'll ping vendor liaisons for firmware eta.
Derek: will prep a short runbook for rollback and SKU gating.
Nina: invite sent.
Lina: thanks all :rocket:
